title: She Wasn't Angry. She Had Just Stopped Telling Him.
description: A tired wife explains to her distracted husband that her quietness is distance rather than peace, prompting him to put down his phone and listen.
target_audience: Married couples and young adults navigating long-term relationship communication.
moral: Silence in a marriage is not always peace; sometimes it is just the quiet sound of a door closing.
